name: Naruz
source: Naruz-The-Wind is the proud and formidable queen of the orcish homeland, Daoyuen. Known for her sharp wit and unwavering confidence, she embodies the spirit of her people, who call themselves "The Axe", a testament to their origins as divine weapons forced in the First War in Heaven. Naruz commands respect as a leader, both for her mastery in taming powerful beasts like war rhinos and for her defiance against subtlety and veiled threats, preferring directness and strength. Naruz-The-Wind is a figure of strength and independence, deeply tied to the traditions and identity of her people.
